Friday, November twentieth. The front page of Wall Street.
The Nasdaq lost ten percent in one week.
Every gain of twenty twenty-six is gone.
The stock fell fourteen percent in a single day, and almost half since October.
About two and a half trillion dollars in value, gone in six weeks.
Anthropic went public on Thursday, at eighty-three dollars a share.
On day one, it jumped above one hundred fifteen.
By Friday, it was back at eighty-nine.
And in the money section, interest rates.
The ten-year rate in America is above five percent.
That makes profits far in the future look less exciting.
So, is the AI boom over?
Or is this the sale of the year?
